issues.detail: The Vietnamese 'vì giờ Ngài chưa đến' (because the hour of His coming has not yet arrived) changes the meaning. The Greek 'ουπω εληλυθει η ωρα αυτου' in this context refers to the 'hour' of his arrest/judgment (the appointed time for the event), not a future 'coming' or 'arrival' in a general sense.
